body.raw:
{
    "name": "Low Platform Batch Task",
    "description": "Task to execute a command on the server",
    "taskType": "LOW_PLATFORM_BATCH",
    "status": "INACTIVE",
    "cronExpression": "0 0 2 * * ?",
    "maxRetries": 2,
    "retryDelaySeconds": 120,
    "lowPlatformBatchConfig": {
        "command": "python /path/to/script.py --param value",
        "workingDirectory": "/opt/scripts",
        "environmentVariables": "ENV_VAR1=value1\nENV_VAR2=value2",
        "successExitCodes": "0,1",
        "onSuccessCommand": "echo 'Success' >> /var/log/batch.log",
        "onFailureCommand": "echo 'Failure' >> /var/log/batch.log",
        "timeoutSeconds": 300
    }
}

request.description: Create a Low Platform Batch task

{
    "name": "High Platform Batch Task",
    "description": "Task to execute a mainframe job",
    "taskType": "HIGH_PLATFORM_BATCH",
    "status": "INACTIVE",
    "cronExpression": "0 0 3 * * ?",
    "maxRetries": 1,
    "retryDelaySeconds": 300,
    "highPlatformBatchConfig": {
        "systemType": "JES",
        "jobName": "BATCH001",
        "parameters": "PARAM1=VALUE1,PARAM2=VALUE2",
        "credentials": "username:password",
        "connectionDetails": "host=mainframe.example.com,port=23",
        "timeoutSeconds": 600
    }
}
